ns2:course.label: Nutrition and the Life Cycle
ns2:course.description: Examines physiological changes that occur during gestation, postnatal growth, and aging and the influence of these changes on nutritional requirements. Prerequisite: FSHN 220 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FSHN 220 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Food Science & Human Nutrition or Nutrition major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
